name: Kiora
description: Kiora is a merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar who bonds with sea monsters and wields a bident she stole from the god Thassa.

description_citations.text: "Kiora". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Kiora is a merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar who bonds with sea monsters and wields a bident she stole from the god Thassa.

citations.text: "Kiora". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, she arrived on Theros, summoned a leviathan, and let the tritons take her for a god's emissary.

citations.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.
"Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.
"Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

bio.text: She fought Thassa, then took the bident and planeswalked away with it.

citations.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

bio.text: Returning to Zendikar, she reunited with her sister Turi and drove the Eldrazi off merfolk refugees with the bident before going to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog.

citations.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.
"Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.
"Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

bio.text: At Sea Gate she insisted on attacking Ulamog and struck at Jace with the bident when he tried to read her mind.

citations.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

bio.text: She summoned Lorthos to fight, but Kozilek cleaved Lorthos in two and she fell into the water and dropped the bident, and she recovered it with Jori's help.

citations.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.
"The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.
"Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

bio.text: In the final stand she cleared Eldrazi, argued that Zendikar would die with the titans, and hurled the Halimar Sea at Nissa before leaving with the bident.

citations.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

bio.text: She later joined the pack of planeswalkers on Ravnica during the War of the Spark.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

status.text: As of the latest events recorded, Kiora is alive and met the pack on Ravnica during the War of the Spark, still wielding the bident.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons Lorthos across Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Kiora summoned Lorthos across Zendikar

citation.text: "Summon", section "Mirage and onwards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
timeline.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives on Theros and raises a huge wave to call sea beasts, damaging the shore near Meletis.
timeline.quote: she raised up an enormous wave to call to the ocean beasts.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The tritons encounter Kiora riding a conjured leviathan and some believe she is a herald of Thassa.
timeline.quote: Some tritons believe that Kiora is an avatar or herald of Thassa, god of the sea.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kiora, unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, continues her search and planeswalks through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives in a new ocean and tastes a new world.
timeline.quote: Kiora swam, and tasted a new world.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora casts a massive upwelling spell to draw out the titans of the deep, sending a wave toward shore, but nothing answers.
timeline.quote: Immense and sluggish currents flowed together directly below her

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons a leviathan from another world and rides it toward shore.
timeline.quote: The leviathan rose beneath her and she clung to its spines.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora meets native tritons and learns she is on Theros near Meletis, where they take her for Thassa.
timeline.quote: "You are on Theros ," he said. "You are in the mortal world."

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora lets the tritons believe she is a god and privately questions Kalemnos about whether he believes she is Thassa.
timeline.quote: "And do you believe I am Thassa?"

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kalemnos guesses Kiora is Thassa's emissary and agrees to help her find the sea's mightiest children.
timeline.quote: I believe you may be her emissary, sent to guide us while she is absent.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora declares a quest from Thassa and leads the tritons out to the open sea on the leviathan to hunt krakens.
timeline.quote: "Then consider this a quest from Thassa," said Kiora.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Callaphe is revealed to be the planeswalker Kiora.
timeline.quote: Callaphe revealed that her identity was a falsehood and that she was in truth the merfolk planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Posing as the mariner Callaphe, Kiora is hired by Ajani and Elspeth to take them to the Temple of Mystery.
timeline.quote: One such facade she adopted was that of Callaphe

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora leads them to Arixmethes, a kraken, and Thassa refuses to let Kiora take it while helping Elspeth and Ajani.
timeline.quote: a massive kraken upon whom a city had been built

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a battle with sea monsters, Kiora escapes with Thassa's bident Dekella.
timeline.quote: Kiora escaped mostly unharmed and clutching Thassa's magical bident Dekella .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
timeline.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaps onto the back of Arixmethes and reveals to Ajani and Elspeth that she is not Callaphe, then leaves them to the Monsoon.
timeline.quote: "Not even close," Kiora replied, smiling back at him.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora dives beneath the waves as Thassa, as the Great Eye, bursts from the water.
timeline.quote: Kiora cast a spell to aid her swimming

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: On the sea bed Kiora calls to the krakens and leviathans Thassa kept in the deep and summons sea-beasts from many worlds.
timeline.quote: she gathered to her the essence of every sea-beast she had ever called her own.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa shifts into her triton form and summons the krakens of Theros as Arixmethes sides with her.
timeline.quote: He was also, for the moment, on Thassa's side.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: The two armies clash as hundreds of tritons arrive to watch; Thassa taunts Kiora.
timeline.quote: "Bear witness to the fall of the pretender!"

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tries to wrest Arixmethes from Thassa by bonding with his mind, but fails.
timeline.quote: You are not mine

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora's serpent turns on her and devours dozens of tritons, and half her krakens turn against her.
timeline.quote: devouring dozens in one bite.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora banishes her serpent and the traitor krakens and falls, cushioning her fall with roots and vines from the sea floor.
timeline.quote: she pulled roots and vines up out of ground that had never seen the sun

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa parts the sea into an arena, accuses Kiora of leading her people astray, and pins her to a boulder with the thrown bident.
timeline.quote: It slammed into her and pinned her to one of the boulders

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora takes the bident and planeswalks away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.
timeline.quote: melted away into the void, Thassa's weapon still clutched in her hands.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora planeswalks to Zendikar still clutching Thassa's bident, which dries to coral.
timeline.quote: There, still clutched tightly in both hands, was the weapon of a god.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds a beach of grey Eldrazi dust and senses dead places across the sea.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi in the oceans!

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
timeline.quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
timeline.quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Kozilek and Emrakul have not been seen for months and that Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "No one's seen him in months," she said.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
timeline.quote: A great wave broke over and around her

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora promises Turi she will return, and half a dozen of Cosi's devotees follow her on a serpent toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: And half a dozen of the merfolk quietly came and stood beside her.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals a bident from a god on another world.
timeline.quote: Having gone to the trouble of stealing a bident from a god on another world, Kiora was eager to test its capabilities.

citation.text: Tightening Coils (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon's army, joined by Kiora and Nissa, retakes Sea Gate and Ulamog is trapped with hedrons.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were driven from the city

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A serpent swallows Kiora and Turi's exploration; Kiora distracts it, her spark ignites, and she promises Turi to return home.
timeline.quote: In that moment of boiling panic, her planeswalker's spark ignited.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora lands on Theros and calls a tsunami that devastates Meletis, and the Tritons take her for an avatar of Thassa.
timeline.quote: It struck the polis of Meletis and caused untold destruction

citation.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives with merfolk and sea monster reinforcements for the Liberation of Sea Gate, meets Gideon, and they retake the city together.
timeline.quote: After 2 more days of fighting, they had retaken Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tazri meets Nissa and Kiora and urges evacuation while Gideon, Drana and Kiora plan to fight the titan; Jace proposes trapping Ulamog with the hedron network.
timeline.quote: saying Ulamog could be trapped using an aligned hedron network.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa and Kiora retakes Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora assaulted and retook Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon takes command and gathers allies including Malakir vampires, Noyan Dar Roil-mages and Kiora's merfolk army to retake Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura took command, and started gathering allies to take the offensive.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
timeline.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora appears on the tentacle of an enormous octopus and introduces herself, claiming command of her own army and the city.
timeline.quote: "I am Kiora," the merfolk said.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons a wave and her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi, announcing the battle of Sea Gate has begun.
timeline.quote: The ocean churned as sharks and whales, serpents and krakens, tore into the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
timeline.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
timeline.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
timeline.quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
timeline.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora descends from Sea Gate on an octopus tentacle to rejoin her own army of tricksters and sea monsters after the other planeswalkers dismiss her.
timeline.quote: five of Cosi's own tricksters and a legion of sea monsters.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
timeline.quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaves three tricksters at Sea Gate and swims out to open water with Shen, Yesha and half her armada.
timeline.quote: Kiora turned and swam away from Sea Gate, out into the open ocean.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora channels the bident through the sea and reaches to Murasa to wake Lorthos.
timeline.quote: The bident was calling. He would answer.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons Lorthos, who appears as a vast darkness, and she pleads with him to fight the interlopers.
timeline.quote: She summoned, and he came!

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
timeline.quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.
timeline.quote: Another and he stood before Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Cosi always won and that she has been tricked, as Kozilek turns toward her.
timeline.quote: Cosi always won.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek takes control of Shen, who lunges at Kiora, and she kills him with the bident.
timeline.quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora falls into the water and drops the bident.
timeline.quote: Lorthos's body shuddered and split

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Kozilek never saw her and that she has killed her followers, then loses consciousness.
timeline.quote: She hit the water, and blackness claimed her.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
timeline.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch chooses a direct attack: Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura rallied the Zendikari defenders to lead the titans into the ambush

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora betrays the group, lifting the Halimar Sea to hurl at Nissa; Jace deflects it onto the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: and turned against them

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora walks away from the battlefield.
timeline.quote: Kiora walked away from the scene of the battle

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace plans to kill the titans by binding Kozilek and Ulamog to Zendikar with a leyline pattern, using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora 's help.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek are incinerated by Chandra's flames channeled through Nissa.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kozilek slices Lorthos in half and turns on Kiora, who is left wounded.
timeline.quote: the titan destroyed Lorthos by slicing it in half using its arm blades

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jori En finds the wounded Kiora and they retrieve her bident.
timeline.quote: Jori En found the wounded Kiora amidst a mass of dead sea creatures.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora urges releasing the titans but Chandra burns them through Nissa's ley lines, destroying Ulamog and Kozilek; Kiora leaves alone.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch and Kiora, devising a leyline plan with Nissa and using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora's help.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jori hears a cry for help and finds Kiora with a compound leg fracture, who says Cosi won and the bident is gone.
timeline.quote: Cosi won,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori sets and splints Kiora's leg, and green energy heals the wound.
timeline.quote: a cluster of green motes fluttered to life around the wound.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora asks Jori's help to recover the bident, which she calls their only hope, and Jori agrees to show her the way.
timeline.quote: Now we just need to recover the bident.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Following a strange current, Jori and Kiora swim into a cliff and are dragged through a rift, a Kozilek spawn guarding the way until the crevasse collapses on it.
timeline.quote: All at once, the crevasse collapsed in on itself and the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: In Kozilek's reshaped caves, Kiora senses the bident beyond a ravine.
timeline.quote: The bident is that way,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori guides a panicking Kiora through a very narrow tunnel as the bident moves ahead.
timeline.quote: Keep your eyes on me, Kiora.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora reclaims the bident and uses it to flood the caves, carrying both merfolk out on a torrent.
timeline.quote: Kiora had compelled the ocean to strip the land away.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
timeline.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes the titan Kozilek is a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities, not a god.
timeline.quote: Not a trickster, but a trick.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
timeline.quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora empties the Halimar Sea and hurls it at Nissa, but Jace splits it into mist.
timeline.quote: But the sea split in two, and each half split in two

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

citation.text: Temple of the False God (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
